expected.source: USDA FoodData Central, SR Legacy, FDC ID 170720: McDONALD'S, BIG MAC; values for 219 g (1 item = 219 g).

cases.message: I ate one regular 2 oz Snickers bar.

expected.source: Mars Wrigley (US), SNICKERS Full Size Milk Chocolate Candy Bar, 1.86 oz, https://www.snickers.com/products/chocolate/snickers-full-size-milk-chocolate-candy-bar-186-oz-bars, checked 2026-11-15; values for 1 bar. Mars sells no 2 oz Snickers bar, so this regular bar is the one the message means. The page for a bag of the same bars gives 4 g of protein.
